# Leave Policy

Overview of how leave works at the company.

## Annual leave

Employees receive 25 days of annual leave. Unused PTO carries over up to five days into the next year.

## Sick leave

Sick leave requires a doctor's note after three consecutive days.

```python
def carry_over(days):
    return min(days, 5)
```

| Type | Days |
|------|------|
| Annual | 25 |
| Sick | 10 |
